items.source: When partial message support is available and requested via WebSocketHandler.supportsPartialMessages(), this method returns true if the current message is the last part of the complete WebSocket message sent by the client. Otherwise false is returned if partial message support is either not available or not enabled.
items.translation: 当通过WebSocketHandler.supportsPartialMessages()启用并请求部分消息支持时，如果当前消息是客户端发送的完整 WebSocket 消息的最后一部分，则此方法返回true；否则，如果不可用或未启用部分消息支持，则返回false。

items.source: When partial message support is available and requested via WebSocketHandler.supportsPartialMessages(), this method returns true if the current message is the last part of the complete WebSocket message sent by the client.
items.translation: 当通过WebSocketHandler.supportsPartialMessages()启用并请求部分消息支持时，如果当前消息是客户端发送的完整 WebSocket 消息的最后一部分，则此方法返回true。

items.source: Return the number of bytes contained in the message.
items.translation: 返回消息中包含的字节数。

items.source: A message that can be handled or sent on a WebSocket connection.
items.translation: 可在 WebSocket 连接上处理或发送的消息。
